Strategy: Widen the gentle fifteen sweet band to residuals between twenty-eight and forty-eight and gate it behind at least five open bins, keeping the mid penalty at fifteen. This combines the widened band with the best gate, but the wider bonus may reward many bins and blur into Best Fit.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (15 if len(bins) >= 5 and r - item >= 28 and r - item <= 48 else 0) - (15 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
